merchant_pricing.title: Catalog Review
merchant_pricing.description: Approve merchant price suggestions and new products before customers see them
merchant_pricing.search: Search by product, store, merchant or barcode
merchant_pricing.showing_oldest: Showing the oldest {shown} of {total} — decide these to see the rest.

stats.applied_desc: live — auto within ±20% or approved by staff

review.title: Review Price Suggestion
review.over_tolerance: This suggestion is outside the ±20% tolerance.
review.product_pending: This product itself is still waiting for approval (New Products tab). Customers won't see it at any price until it's approved.
review.accept_hint: Approving makes the suggested price the live selling price. The merchant is notified either way.
review.note_hint: Only sent if you reject — required then, and shown to the merchant. Approving ignores it.
review.note_placeholder: e.g. Too far above the market price for this product…
review.note_required: Add a note so the merchant knows why it was rejected.

history.applied_hint: “Price applied” means the suggested price is live — applied automatically when it was within ±20%, or approved by staff.

errors.network: Couldn't reach Blink Server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.session: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.forbidden: Your staff role isn't allowed to review the catalog.
errors.not_found: This product no longer exists. The list has been refreshed.
errors.invalid: Blink Server refused this decision. A rejection needs a reason. ({detail})
errors.conflict: This item changed or was already decided since you opened it. The list has been refreshed — reopen it to review the latest version.
errors.throttled: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

empty.prices: No price suggestions waiting. All caught up!
empty.products: No new products waiting for approval.
